poc_metrics: Trial duration: 6 weeks; total tokens processed: ~3.2M
Traffic shape: average QPS during peak week: 38 QPS; 95th percentile QPS observed in burst windows: 132 QPS
Concurrency observed (hosted): typical concurrent requests 45; peak concurrency observed 112 during synthetic load test
Token mix: chat generation requests avg tokens/request = 450 (median 320, 95th = 1,800); embeddings calls avg tokens = 14 per call (short inputs)
Request distribution: 68% short-form assistant (<=400 tokens), 22% medium (401-1200), 10% long (1200+), embeddings 12% of total API calls
Latency targets: product needs p50 < 220ms for short chats; p95 < 800ms acceptable for long-form (but prefer <500ms)
Observed latency on hosted trial (model: redwood-standard-1 / opt): short chat p50=210ms, p95=640ms; long chat p95 spiked to 1.4s under burst

Cost notes: hosted trial cost extrapolation ~= $9k/month at current traffic; Dedicated commit needed for unit-cost predictability — engineering requests price per token and per-embedding metrics for 12/24-mo commits
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Initial recommended Dedicated configs (for procurement): Option A: baseline 3 x L40-equivalent GPUs (handles avg QPS 35, concurrency 50, ~1.2M tokens/day) — good for conservative commit; Option B (preferred): 6 x L40-equivalent GPUs + autoscale slot for bursts (handles sustained avg QPS 60, peak QPS ~140, concurrency 140, ~3.8M tokens/day); Option C: 8+ GPUs for 99th percentile low-latency for long-form workflows. Recommend Option B for first 12 months with autoscaling policy and prefix/KV caching enabled; revisit after 3 months of production telemetry.
